title: Home swipe-to-reply (user 2026-11-20: "using two fingers to swipe on home chief imessage messages fails to reply it"): two-finger trackpad swipes on the newest Chief bubble of the Home fixture, played in real time through the app's event dispatch (debug.home.drive swipe), each recorded as a display video (displayRecord, a whole capture mini): a partial swipe that springs back, a full swipe that opens the reply, a slow full swipe, then a diagonal scroll that must stay a scroll. thread_state after each records what it did. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/home-swipe-reply-motion.json --mac

steps.title: Motion on, whatever the host's Reduce Motion says
The Home chat over the fixture's Chief history
Partial swipe: 40 pt in 0.3 s, held 0.3 s (springs back, no reply)
After the partial swipe: no thread
Its events, as the swipe took or left them
Full swipe: 160 pt in 0.35 s (opens the reply)
After the full swipe: the reply is open
Its events, as the swipe took or left them
Slow full swipe: 120 pt in 0.9 s, held 0.4 s
After the slow swipe: the reply is open
Its events, as the swipe took or left them
Diagonal scroll on the bubble: 100 pt right, 90 pt down in 0.4 s (stays a scroll: the transcript moves, no reply)
After the diagonal scroll: no thread
Its events, as the swipe took or left them
